known_risks: 修改预设后必须重启或重新载入游戏，再重新吃饭；Cemu 只在标题加载时解析并应用 Graphic Pack 参数，补丁也不会追溯修改已经完成的猫饭。 / After changing presets, restart or reload the title and then eat again; Cemu resolves and applies Graphic Pack parameters only when loading the title, and the patch does not retroactively alter an already completed meal.

餐前预览可能仍显示游戏原本随机生成的技能；本补丁在生成器返回后覆盖原生临时槽，用餐完成后的显示、任务状态和实际效果需要实机验证。 / The pre-meal preview may still show game-generated skills; this patch replaces the native temporary slots after the generator returns, while the post-meal display, quest state, and actual effects still require gameplay validation.
游戏原生互斥或非法组合可能只生效其中一项；已知 0x41 与 0x1E incompatible、不能共存。 / Native mutually exclusive or invalid combinations may apply only one effect; 0x41 and 0x1E are known to be incompatible.

当前仅有静态映射、固定 RPX 与安装验证，状态保持 Runtime Experimental / Gameplay Pending。 / Evidence is currently limited to static mapping, pinned-RPX, and installation checks, so status remains Runtime Experimental / Gameplay Pending.

summary: 提供 0x00..0x41 的三槽双语猫饭技能选择；在随机生成器返回后覆盖原生临时槽，再由原生循环同步菜单与任务运行状态；默认关闭，待实机验证。 / Provides three bilingual 0x00..0x41 Felyne-food skill selectors; replaces native temporary slots after random generation, then lets the native loop mirror menu and quest runtime state; disabled by default and gameplay pending.
